items.title: Jon Hendricks — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: So Ben Riley and Larry Gales – I sang it. I was singing it for them.

ctx.x: Now that’s what I wrote, but they didn’t say that. They said, “And then it was a drag.” Monk let him sit in. So I wrote these words in about 15 minutes. So Ben Riley and Larry Gales – I sang it. I was singing it for them. I had no idea that the engineer had turned the switch on. I had no idea that it was going to be on an album. When I picked up the album and saw it was on the album, I couldn’t believe it.
